name: acceptance
description: > End-to-end verification and self-evidence for a delivery in any repository, with or without a preconfigured verify plan. Discover an existing plan when one was handed to this run; otherwise author checks and publish a standalone acceptance. Pick the proving surface (CLI / web / desktop / iOS Simulator), drive the real product, capture visually confirmed evidence, and publish a round with the lh CLI. Triggers on 'verify the task', 'collect evidence', 'prove it works', 'upload evidence', 'verify plan', 'requiredEvidence', 'local test', 'manual test', 'test report', 'test with cli', 'test in electron', 'test desktop', or any local end-to-end verification task. Needs no ambient ids, and never depends on running inside a LobeHub conversation.

name: lobe-design
description: > Single entry for LobeHub UI design work. Routes any instruction — macro ("重做这个后台", "整体打磨一下"), medium ("把列表页的交互和空态补齐") or fine ("这个按钮颜色不对", "修 K-07") — into a business-first, layered pipeline of focused stages: 00 brief → 05 init → 10 decode → 20 direction → 30 structure → 40 flow → 50 visual → 60 system → 70 detail → 75 copy → 80 review. Covers seven scenarios: 0→1 visual pages (landing / portfolio / campaign), polishing existing product UI, admin consoles / dashboards / forms / workflows, design-system unification, screenshot restoration, pre-launch audit, and project bootstrap (AGENTS.md). Grounded in classic analysis models (double diamond, Gestalt, Nielsen heuristics, Kano, peak-end, Fogg, journey map, cognitive load) and in a layered component boundary: take atoms from the host's component library and build business composites yourself. Platform-aware (web / desktop / mobile, read from the project layer): web takes atoms from @lobehub/ui (/form, /pro-table) with cssVar tokens; React Native takes them from the project's own library (e.g. @lobehub/ui-rn) with useTheme() tokens. Web ecosystem: @lobehub/charts / icons / fluent-emoji / streamdown. Runnable lint (platform-gated), route, refs and bootstrap checks; in-product UI copy by product profile (consumer / SaaS / admin / developer), with zh-CN typography. Trigger on lobe-design, lobe-ui, lobehub, LobeChat UI, 控制台, 后台, 看板, 落地页, 官网, 截图还原, 设计稿, 设计系统统一, 打磨, polish, refine, 审查, 上线前检查, 组件选择, 设计准则, AI 味, 文案, 措辞, 中英文空格, 初始化, AGENTS.md.
